posts.title: When the Poet Sings, by Lord Dunsany
posts.description: Here is a newspaper appearance, from the Billings Gazette of 29 April 1934, of a "new" poem by Lord Dunsany. It is titled "When the Poet Sings" but when it was collected in Dunsany's Mirage Water (1938) it appears under the title "The Poet." The headpiece and tailpiece are drawn by artist Marie A. Lawson (1894-1956), the wife of author and artist Robert Lawson (1892-1957).

posts.title: An Issue Point for the first hardcover of Jack Finney's THE BODY SNATCHERS
posts.description: Jack Finney's second novel, The Body Snatchers , was first serialized in shortened form in Collier's magazine in three parts, from 26 November to 24 December 1954. The full novel appeared as a pocked-sized paperback original from Dell, on 1 February 1955. The first hardcover edition came out in England from Eyre & Spottiswoode on 16 September 1955. The novel was filmed as Invasion of the Body Snat
